title: GMAT
description: Documented public astrodynamics software (NASA Goddard (open source)) for the Orbital Mechanics Workbench capability area.
body:
GMAT is a documented astrodynamics software from NASA Goddard (open source). Open-source mission analysis: orbit propagation, maneuvers, estimation, and optimization with validated force models.

How it works: It works by advancing the mean anomaly at the circular-orbit mean motion and rotating the position vector by the swept angle.

Documented uses of this capability area include interplanetary trajectory design, space-station operations, lunar base planning, and asteroid resource assessment.

title: poliastro
description: Documented public Python astrodynamics (Juan Luis Cano (open source)) for the Orbital Mechanics Workbench capability area.
body:
poliastro is a documented Python astrodynamics from Juan Luis Cano (open source). Open-source Python library for interactive orbital mechanics: Lambert transfers, porkchop plots, and maneuver design.

How it works: It works by computing the two Hohmann transfer burns from the vis-viva equation and the half-ellipse transfer time.

Documented uses of this capability area include interplanetary trajectory design, space-station operations, lunar base planning, and asteroid resource assessment.
